desc:
Build your own military base, grow a war economy and fight for the warzone — alone or with a friend!

🏭 BUILD — ammo presses, rifle assemblers, oil pumps and missile factories fill your base with cash.
🏢 MEGA HQ — 4-floor Command HQ with barracks, intel center, command deck, elevator and rooftop helipad.
🔒 SECRET BUNKER — open the blast hatch and rebirth at the glowing Rebirth Core.
🔫 10 WEAPONS — pistol, SMG, shotgun, M4, x4/x8 sniper, LMG, RPG, minigun, railgun. Aim in first person!
🚙 VEHICLES — jeeps, gunner humvees, tanks and attack helicopters. Drive while your friend mans the gun!
🚩 WARZONE — capture outposts, destroy convoys, grab supply drops, call in airstrikes.
🛡️ DEFEND — walls, energy-shield gates, turrets, AA and lasers protect your vault from raiders.
🎁 Daily rewards, quests and a friendly tutorial.

Like ⭐ the game and join Warfront Tycoon Studios for updates!
